OrbMedic · Backend · ML Engineering

OrbMedic

English Overview

At OrbMedic, I worked on a backend and ML pipeline for wearable physiological signals. I helped improve preprocessing throughput through concurrent processing, optimized TensorFlow inference on GPU, and improved feature-generation reliability. I also containerized our synthetic-data pipeline and separated synthetic and real-data ingestion.

01

System Architecture

Wear OS Health API → Kotlin BLE Plugin → Flutter → FastAPI REST → MongoDB → Scheduled Processing → Feature Extraction → Scoring。WebSocket 负责推送状态与结果。

02

50% Throughput

原本逐用户串行处理，改为受限并发。根据 CPU、Memory 和每小时处理用户数调节约 4–6 个 Workers。相同数据、相同硬件对比。

03

30% Inference Performance

TensorFlow 模型在 GPU 上运行，连续 10 秒 Signal 作为输入窗口。调节 Batch Size，根据 GPU Utilization 和 VRAM 做权衡。P95 统计口径需谨慎解释。

04

98% Feature Generation

通过 NeuroKit2、SciPy 预处理和验证逻辑，允许非关键 Feature 出现 NaN，Full + Partial Success 计入成功。评分失败的 Scheduled Retry 属于另一项可靠性改进。

05

Docker & 40% Setup Time

独立为 Synthetic Pipeline 创建 Docker 环境、单元及回归测试，减少新机器的手动配置工作。40% 是前后配置耗时的估算，GitHub Actions 后续由同事主导。

06

Refactoring & BLE

将真实与合成数据分开接入、验证及存储到不同 MongoDB Collections；共用下游处理。维护已有 Kotlin BLE Plugin，处理连接不稳和数据丢失。
